results.content: US equities ended Friday modestly lower, with the S&P 500 down 0.17%, the Nasdaq Composite off 0.28% and the Dow falling around 108 points. The more notable signal came from the economic data. Preliminary University of Michigan consumer sentiment fell to 51.0 in August from 55.2 in July, while July retail sales declined 0.6%, their largest monthly drop since May 2025.

results.content: The University of Michigan's preliminary consumer sentiment index fell to 51.0 in August, down from 55.2 in July and well below the 54.5 median forecast from economists polled by Reuters. The reading snapped two consecutive months of improvement and marked a return to levels last seen during the spring, when gasoline prices were surging. [...] The University of Michigan's preliminary consumer sentiment index fell to 51.0 in August from 55.2 in July, the first decline in three months and well below the 54.5 consensus forecast.
